editorial.blurb: Siam Noodle & Rice is a cozy, unpretentious Thai spot where bold, authentic flavors and generous portions prove that great comfort food doesn't need fancy surroundings.
editorial.insiderTip: Go at lunch to avoid the crowds that pack this place during dinner—the kitchen moves fast, and you'll get your hot food quickly.
signatureDishes: Coconut ice cream with fried banana
